label: Does a conservationist deny the existential giver productive credit for the particular effect?
summary: Durand, redaction C II d.1 q.5 §§6,10–12,17, grants the same act to the giver and conserver of the exercised power mediately. This discriminates denial of immediate divine concurrence from denial of any productive causal credit. Suárez DM XXII.1 §§7–9 challenges a switch in causal mode solely on grounds of an effect’s age when the stated reason concerns its participated character. A uniform mediated account of both phases survives. Fixing the working spring charge screens off its actual winding. That supports the sufficiency of the intermediate, and cannot exclude historical mediated production. Replacing the active power, independent renewal and retained organization discriminate power from mere presence. Two certificates bound the actual source contribution within freely routable balanced integer accounts and exhibit the need for routing information to identify a particular output. See docs/notes/actuality-esse-research.md §12.
blocker: The universal premise requires identifying the very existential giver as giving each relevant productive or constitutive principle. The arithmetic test applies to consumable inputs. A durable or acquired power and a relational determination require independent evidence of provenance and a respect-appropriate causal reading. The same two actual esse links required by b4987085 are also separate from power-mediated credit.
